actionInbox: Quick actions (long press on the icon)
widgetOverview: The overview widget (FlowplanTasks): not "Aufgaben" – that is the suite's widget that checks off.
voiceFile: The file name stays ASCII, like the other languages' names.
updateAllowText: Android's own names in the settings: "Install unknown apps" (de: "Unbekannte Apps installieren", fr: "Installer des applis inconnues", zh: "安装未知应用") and its switch "Allow from this source" (de: "Aus dieser Quelle zulassen", fr: "Autoriser cette source", zh: "允许来自此来源的应用").
updateProgress: Progress of the update download in megabytes (fr: Mo).
errorDetails: Small line under a failed save (scan, share, photo, voice memo). {detail} is an untranslated technical message, e.g. "HTTP 502" or "ERR_UNABLE_TO_UPLOAD: …", for the person to pass on in a bug report.
scanNeedsPlayServices: Android without Google Play services (ML Kit's document scanner runs there). Google's own name of the service: de "Google Play-Dienste", fr "services Google Play", zh "Google Play 服务". The file is a PDF or a photo the person picks instead.
sharePagesSaved: Android share sheet, after files were saved as pages of their own (one page per file) in a space. {count} is a number, {target} the space's name.
